"""Regression test for FND-000004 - hardcoded credential in ledger/db.py.

Asserts a property of the source file rather than of a function: no credential
literal is present. That is the only thing that actually proves the leak is gone.
"""

import pathlib
import re

SOURCE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "ledger" / "db.py"


def test_no_credential_literal_in_source():
    text = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert not re.search(r'(?i)(?<![A-Za-z])(password|dsn|secret)\s*=\s*"[^"]{8,}"', text)


def test_credentials_come_from_the_environment():
    text = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "os.environ" in text
